entities.name: Torņakalns – Tukums II railway line

entities.summary: Torņakalns–Tukums II Railway is a 65 kilometres (40 mi) long, 1,520 mm gauge railway in Latvia, built in the 19th century to connect Riga and Tukums, via the resort town of Jūrmala.
